// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Sets oxygen remaining. It has no effect when soldier is not diving.

|s1= unit [[setOxygenRemaining]] value

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|p2= value: [[Number]] in range 0..1

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
if (!isAbleToBreathe player) then
{
	player setOxygenRemaining 0; // drowns player
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[isAbleToBreathe]] [[getOxygenRemaining]]
}}
